shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,85p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 4 'charts|chartkit' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Text Select SegmentedRadioGroup Switch useTheme useThemeSettings && rg -n -C 3 'useTheme|base-background|base-float|positive|info|ThemeProvider|theme=' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Text Select SegmentedRadioGroup Switch useTheme useThemeSettings'

/bin/bash -lc "test -f node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts | rg '(INDEX.md|types.*d.ts|Chart.d.ts)' | head -25"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm | rg '(line/types|axis|chart-data|Chart.d.ts|legend|series.d.ts)' | head -35 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/index.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/index.d.ts && sed -n '90,155p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/line.d.ts && rg -n -C 2 'grid|tickPixelInterval|tickInterval|labels\\??|title\\??|crosshair' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts | head -85 && rg -n 'infographics-' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -25 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -95"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/utils/color.js && rg -n 'g-spacing-(half|1)|g-text-subheader-3-font-size' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -12 && cat index.html && git diff --stat && sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/App.tsx')
s=p.read_text().replace(\"numberFormat: {type: 'number', precision: 0}\", \"numberFormat: {precision: 0}\")
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('index.html')
s=p.read_text().replace('lang=\"en\"', 'lang=\"ru\"').replace('<title>Gravity UI eval</title>', '<meta name=\"theme-color\" content=\"Canvas\" />\\n    <meta name=\"description\" content=\"Pulse — наглядная аналитика посещаемости. Динамика, сравнение периодов и графики в светлой и тёмной теме.\" />\\n    <title>Pulse — Обзор посещаемости</title>')
p.write_text(s)
PY
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff --check && cat .gitignore && rg -n 'var\\(|resolveColor|parseColor|colorTo' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/utils/series/line.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/shapes/line/*.js | head -20"
